artworks.title: Two Dutch Frigates
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of two sailing ships on the sea. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing the ships with their sails unfurled. The horizon is visible in the upper third of the image, separating the sea from the sky. There are faint indications of distant land or formations. The engraving features detailed line work capturing the textures of the waves and ship rigging. The color palette is monochrome, typical of etchings. The sea shows curling waves with delicate hatchings, while the ships sail forward with billowing sails and fluttering flags. The sky is sketched simply in the background.

artworks.title: "Tocht Schuiten"or Spaarndam Fishing Boats

artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a maritime scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is low in the composition, emphasizing the expansive sky with its clouds. Several boats with sails are docked alongside a wooden pier protruding into the water. The sails are depicted with fine, detailed etching strokes, giving a sense of texture and movement. In the distance, other smaller ships and a faint outline of structures mark the horizon line. The color palette is monochromatic, with variations of black and white. The water, the sky, and the boats blend into a coherent scene capturing a maritime environment.

artworks.title: Bicker's Island, Amsterdam
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is an etched image of a harbor titled "Bickers Eylandt." The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing numerous ships and boats along the docks and in the water. Several boats are moored close by, with dark sails depicted in delicate line work. In the middle distance, larger ships with multiple masts and flags are docked. A windmill is seen on the horizon. The etching technique includes fine cross-hatched lines depicting various textures. The color palette is monochrome. The sky has wispy clouds. A small structure with a figure on the porch is visible behind the pier.

artworks.title: The "Salemander," an East-Indian Merchantman
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a meticulously drawn ship with intricate details, highlighting its elaborate design. The hull, rigging, and sails are carefully rendered with fine lines, showcasing the structure and texture of the ship. The sails, mostly furled, display texture through parallel lines, conveying a sense of movement. The ship dominates the composition, positioned prominently in the scene, with a low horizon marking the calm sea. A smaller boat with figures and a flag, as well as a faintly visible ship in the distance, completes the tranquil seascape. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing light and dark contrast for depth. The artwork conveys a sense of historical and maritime significance, evident in the precise detail of the etching.

artworks.title: A Damschuit and a "Smalschip"

artworks.description: The image shows a seascape from a low vantage point, with a high horizon separating the sea and the sky. Two sailing ships are depicted in the rough waters: a larger vessel to the right and a smaller ship to the left. The etching technique is used for detailed line work and bold strokes. The monochrome palette enhances the contrast between the sea and the sky. Other distant sails are faintly visible against the cloudy skies.

artworks.title: The Gelderse Quay and the Schreiers Tower, Amsterdam
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The J. and H. Weldon Foundation Inc. and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view of a historical city waterfront with a bustling harbor scene. The perspective is from the water level, displaying a busy port filled with wooden boats of various sizes. Close to us, several small boats are shown with figures engaged in rowing or attending to their vessels. The horizon line is defined by the intricate masts of sail ships clustered at a dock in the distance, partially obscured by a wooden bridge crossing the waterway. The bridge is populated with people and is a central feature of the composition. On the left, there is a prominent building with a tower-like structure, framed by tall ships with raised sails and fluttering flags. The brushstrokes reveal fine detailing characteristic of etching techniques, capturing the textures of sails, structural elements, and the water's surface. The color palette includes shades of grey and brown typical of etching prints, emphasizing line work and the contrast between the sky and the land. In the background, clumps of trees are etched with hatching, providing a natural boundary to the scene, enveloping the architecture and further forms beyond the bridge.
